about: GH #326 phase 5b parity cases. The Rust `attach_failure_diagnosis` derivation (agent-doc-editor-surface-io) and the plugin's frozen Kotlin floor (AttachFailureDiagnosisTest) both answer every case. `input` is exactly what the plugin sends: the recorded failure reason and, for the operator notification, the document's file name. The answer also owns whether another attach is automatic or must await operator evidence. An absent field is omitted. A native rule change updates this file and may diverge from the frozen floor only on purpose. A case whose native answer diverged on purpose keeps the frozen floor's answer in `frozen_expected`.

cases.name: an IDE running a plugin generation older than the install names a restart

input.reason: controller_error: replica_register_detached_authority: registration carried no live editor pid

expected.remedy: Restart the IDE. The controller saw no live editor PID on the registration, which is what a plugin generation loaded before the current install sends. Reloading the native library or recycling the controller cannot replace a loaded plugin generation.

cases.name: no listening controller names the project controller

expected.remedy: No project controller is listening for that document's project root; start or recycle it.

cases.name: a plain markdown file is not a session document

expected.remedy: That file is not an agent-doc session document (no agent_doc_* frontmatter, no <!-- agent: markers).

cases.name: a restarted editor without a settled ancestor is surfaced with its own remedy

expected.remedy: The restarted editor has no settled ancestor from which it can safely seed the retained controller projection. Copy any unsaved text, close this editor tab, run `agent-doc repair <file>` while it is detached, and reopen it; restarting the editor again cannot create that ancestor.
expected.hold_message: Agent Doc could not attach the open editor replica for plan.md. Cause: retained-reseed-missing-settled-shadow. The restarted editor has no settled ancestor from which it can safely seed the retained controller projection. Copy any unsaved text, close this editor tab, run `agent-doc repair <file>` while it is detached, and reopen it; restarting the editor again cannot create that ancestor. The editor buffer and disk were left unchanged.

cases.name: an attach that outlived its wait asks the operator to wait

expected.remedy: Registration is still running; wait for the next editor status update before retrying.

cases.name: an unloaded FFI never prescribes its unreachable reload endpoint

expected.remedy: Inspect About Agent Doc or the IDE log for the executable and library that failed to load. Fix or remove that incompatible install so PATH resolves to the intended agent-doc; the native loader retries automatically. `agent-doc admin reload-lib` cannot reach this editor until FFI loads.
